title: True Love's Kiss
intro: Welcome in to Disney Jeopardy! [excited] Today's episode is for all the hopeless romantics out there. We've got couples, love songs, wedding venues and one very questionable bride. Grab your sweetheart, or your snack... [chuckles] which is basically the same thing.

art.prompt: A romantic moonlit fairy-tale balcony overlooking a glowing castle, floating heart-shaped lanterns, rose petals drifting through the air, fireworks blooming in pink and gold over a calm lake, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Tale as Old as Time
categories.intro: Our film category is the love story of all love stories. [excited] Be our guest for some Beauty and the Beast!

art.prompt: A grand golden ballroom with crystal chandeliers and a polished marble floor, a single enchanted red rose glowing under a glass dome on a table, snowy castle windows behind, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: The Beast keeps this enchanted flower under a glass dome in the West Wing.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a rose! When the last petal falls, the spell is permanent. [sarcastic] No pressure, Beast.

clues.clue: Belle's inventor father is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maurice! Philippe is the horse, by the way. [laughs] The horse is the one with common sense.

clues.clue: The Beast wins Belle's heart by giving her this enormous room as a gift.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the library! Honestly, the GREATEST gift in Disney history. Sorry, glass slippers.

clues.clue: The Enchantress's spell becomes permanent if the Beast doesn't learn to love by this birthday.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is his 21st year! Which means, do the math, the Beast was about eleven when that spell hit. [sighs] Rough childhood.

clues.clue: Beauty and the Beast made history as the first animated feature ever nominated for this Oscar.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Best Picture! [dramatic pause] It lost to The Silence of the Lambs. Talk about a Beauty and a Beast of a race.

categories.title: Love Is an Open Door
categories.intro: Next, some famous Disney couples! I'll describe one sweetheart, you name the other. [whispers] How romantic.

art.prompt: Two mismatched front doors side by side in a whimsical village, one opening onto a sunny meadow and the other onto a starry sky, a ribbon of hearts linking them, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Mickey Mouse's longtime sweetheart, with a polka-dot bow.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Minnie Mouse! Together since 1928. Hollywood's longest-running couple, and they still hold hands. [sighs]

clues.clue: In Tangled, Rapunzel falls for this smooth-talking thief with a famous smolder.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Flynn Rider, also known as Eugene Fitzherbert! [laughs] Frying pans... who knew? Turns out they're the key to romance.

clues.clue: In Cars, Lightning McQueen falls for this blue Porsche who runs the Cozy Cone Motel.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sally Carrera! She's a 2002 Porsche 911. [chuckles] Lightning really knows how to pick them.

clues.clue: In 1973's Robin Hood, Robin is head over tail for this lovely vixen.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maid Marian! Her lady-in-waiting, Lady Kluck, is the real MVP of that film. Go KLUCK!

clues.clue: In Encanto, Dolores can hear everything, including the heartbeat of her secret crush, this suitor.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mariano! Bruno predicted he'd marry Isabela, but in the end he ends up with Dolores. [whispers] We don't talk about it... but we're happy for them.

categories.title: Whispers of Love
categories.intro: It's our media category! You'll hear a famous romantic line from a Disney or Lucasfilm movie. You tell me who said it. [whispers] Get your tissues ready.

art.prompt: An old-fashioned radio microphone surrounded by love letters, a bundle of red roses and floating heart-shaped sound waves in soft pink stage light, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Name the character who said this line.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Olaf! He said it while practically melting next to the fire for Anna. [laughs] Put a snowman on your Valentine's card.
clues.quote: Some people are worth melting for.

clues.clue: This scoundrel's answer when told 'I love you.'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Han Solo! Leia says I love you, Han says I know. [chuckles] The coolest, most frustrating answer in galaxy history.

clues.clue: Who wrote these words in a very special scrapbook?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ellie! That last page of her Adventure Book still gets me every single time. [sighs] Somebody pass the tissues.
clues.quote: Thanks for the adventure. Now go have a new one!

clues.clue: Name the sassy character who said this line to her future hero.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Megara! Meg to her friends. She won't say she's in love, but we ALL know the truth.
clues.quote: I'm a damsel. I'm in distress. I can handle this. Have a nice day.

clues.clue: Name the character who said this line in 1995.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is John Smith! He said it to Pocahontas while held captive. Mel Gibson did the voice, and the swooning, apparently. [laughs]
clues.quote: I'd rather die tomorrow than live a hundred years without knowing you.

categories.title: Love at the Parks
categories.intro: Our Parks category is for the lovebirds. Romance, weddings, and one VERY dangerous bride.

art.prompt: A glowing fairy-tale castle at night with fireworks overhead, a candlelit Italian restaurant table with one plate of spaghetti on Main Street, and a spooky gothic attic with a wedding veil in shadow, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: This Magic Kingdom nighttime spectacular shares its name with the way fairy tales end.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Happily Ever After! It's back lighting up Cinderella Castle. [excited] Grab your sweetheart and a good viewing spot.

clues.clue: This Main Street restaurant at Magic Kingdom is themed to the Italian eatery where Lady and the Tramp share spaghetti.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tony's Town Square Restaurant! [sighs] Bella notte. Sharing one noodle is optional, but highly encouraged.

clues.clue: Couples say I do at this Walt Disney World venue, where a big window behind the altar frames a view of Cinderella Castle.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Wedding Pavilion, near the Grand Floridian! Something old, something new, something borrowed, something MICKEY.

clues.clue: In the Haunted Mansion attic, this black widow bride says I do to husband after husband, each of whom loses his head.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Constance Hatchaway! [mischievously] Till death do us part, and she means it. Hold onto your head when you ride by.

clues.clue: Walt and his wife Lillian stayed in a small apartment above this Disneyland Main Street building, where a lamp still glows in the window.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Fire Station! Cast members keep that lamp lit to remind everyone that Walt is still in the park, in spirit. [sighs]

categories.title: Rhyme Time: Sweethearts
categories.intro: And the fan category is Rhyme Time, sweetheart edition! I'll give you two clues. [excited] Combine the answers into a perfect rhyme.

art.prompt: Two heart-shaped puzzle pieces clicking together surrounded by swirling poetry quills, candy hearts and little floating musical notes, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Belle's furry, horned husband plus a giant holiday dinner.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Beast Feast! Which, to be fair, is exactly what Be Our Guest is all about. [laughs]

clues.clue: The thief who steals Rapunzel's heart plus a big happy smile.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Flynn Grin! Although, let's be honest, he'd prefer you call it... [dramatic pause] the smolder.

clues.clue: WALL-E's sleek robot crush plus the part of a shirt that covers your arm.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is EVE Sleeve! [chuckles] Handy for hiding a plasma cannon... or the lightbulb WALL-E gave her.

clues.clue: Mulan's army captain and eventual love plus a group of troublemakers.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Shang Gang! Yao, Ling and Chien-Po would definitely be card-carrying members.

clues.clue: Linguini's tough-as-nails line cook girlfriend plus a spinning casino game.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Colette Roulette! Spin the wheel, and whatever it lands on, [laughs] Colette will still tell you to keep your station clean.
